meanings.note: informal: Бред какой-то! = What nonsense!
Medical. Common masculine noun meaning 'nonsense; delirium' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Бред какой-то. Но, с другой стороны, чем я рискую?
examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be; there is'.
future: буду / будешь ... + infinitive

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: For emphasis.

examples.trans: I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.

meanings.note: Colloquial. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to lie, to tell lies', paired with 'соврать'.

examples.text: Не надо врать. Стену монастыря сносят!
examples.trans: Don't lie. They're pulling down the monastery wall!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Disbelief. Core Russian part meaning 'yes' in everyday speech.

держаться.gloss: to hold on; to stick with

meanings.note: за + accusative: держись за руку = hold on to my hand

meanings.en: to stick with, keep close to
meanings.note: + genitive: держитесь меня = stick with me

Держись! = hang in there!. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hold on; to stick with'.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё у вас будет хорошо. Потому что я кто?
examples.trans: Stick with me, and everything will be fine for you. Because who am I?

meanings.note: + genitive. Core Russian prep meaning 'until, before; up to' in everyday speech.
Core Russian prep meaning 'until, before; up to' in everyday speech.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

договариваться.gloss: to agree, to make a deal

meanings.en: to agree, to have an agreement
meanings.note: + с + instrumental. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to agree, to make a deal', paired with 'договориться'.

examples.text: Как же так? Мы же с вами договаривались!
examples.trans: How can this be? We had an agreement!

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Спасибо за + accusative. Core Russian prep meaning 'for; behind' in everyday speech.
+ instrumental. Core Russian prep meaning 'for; behind' in everyday speech.
Parenthetical. Core Russian adv meaning 'so, then, that means' in everyday speech.
verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?
что это значит? = what does this mean?

examples.trans: Pasha, what does all this mean?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to
meanings.note: + dative (кому). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.
+ accusative (что). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.

examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you.

examples.text: Эдик, я хотела тебе изменить. С ним, чтобы отомстить.
examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you. With him, to take revenge.

meanings.en: to cheat on, be unfaithful to
meanings.note: + dat. Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cheat, be unfaithful', paired with 'изменить'.

+ acc. Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cheat, be unfaithful', paired with 'изменить'.

examples.trans: He never cheated on his wife.

meanings.note: Core Russian conj meaning 'or' in everyday speech.
мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

Кажется as a parenthetical word. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to seem', paired with 'показаться'.

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

meanings.note: Impersonal predicate or adverb. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: It's easy for you to say.

examples.text: Да это легко. Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Come on, it's easy. Grab the little dog in the park and run.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('best; better').

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: Agrees with the thing owned. Core Russian det meaning 'my, mine' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.

Polite request. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'казать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to say, to tell', paired with 'говорить'.

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: + accusative. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'
'Слушаю' = I'm listening. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.
